title: UK CBAM default values (HMRC, published 16 October 2026) — transcription
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. HM Revenue & Customs, 'Check the default values for the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)'.
notes: Values were typed from the GOV.UK pages into GCC-carbon-data.xlsx on 11 November 2026 and were NOT compared digit by digit with the source. GOV.UK could not be reached from the build environment to re-check them. Default values are conservative regulatory figures, not measurements of any factory. For iron and steel the description is the general HS 6-digit wording, not the UK 8-digit wording.

defaults.methodology: UK CBAM default value published by HMRC; a conservative regulatory figure, not a measurement
defaults.hs_evidence: First six digits of the commodity code in the UK CBAM default-values table
defaults.source_limitations: Transcribed by hand and not re-checked against GOV.UK. Regulatory default, not a measured footprint. Check the source page before formal use.

title: ADEME Impact CO2 — everyday product averages (values.json)
attribution: ADEME Impact CO2 (incubateur-ademe/impactco2), Copyright (c) 2022 Datagir, MIT License.
notes: CSV derived from the unmodified upstream values.json (value in g CO2e divided by 1000; unit read from the upstream English label). French averages. Six digital devices already covered by Boavizta product types are left out to avoid repeats. The licence of the underlying ADEME figures beyond the repository's MIT licence was not confirmed.

defaults.methodology: ADEME Impact CO2 average value for France
defaults.source_limitations: An average for France, not a specific product. No publication year is given in the source file.
